core_vibe: Feminine, festive, premium, rooted in Indian/South Asian beauty culture yet modern and sophisticated.

background.description: Warm Ivory and Pearl bases to create a luxurious, organic, skin-like canvas. Avoid pure white.

primary.name: Deep Crimson / Maroon
primary.description: Rich, festive maroon reminiscent of traditional Sindoor, Bindi, and Mehndi hues. Used for primary CTAs and emphasis.

secondary.name: Deep Forest / Mehendi Green
secondary.description: Grounding dark green inspired by fresh henna leaves. Used for high-contrast text and footer backgrounds.

rules: No purple or teal anywhere in the UI.
No flat gradients. Use metallic/shimmer gradients (gold/champagne) for accents.
Primary CTAs must be Deep Crimson with Gold/Rose Gold text or hover states.

headings.usage: H1-H3. Elegant, editorial, high-fashion. Must use tight tracking (tracking-tight) for large sizes.

body.usage: Clean, modern sans for legibility and contemporary balance. Used for all paragraphs, labels, and small UI text.

layout_and_spacing.philosophy: Editorial and spacious. Treat products like art pieces in a gallery.
layout_and_spacing.spacing: Generous paddings (p-12, p-16, py-24). Elements must have room to breathe.

grids.hero: Asymmetrical editorial layout. Image overlapping text or a side-by-side with heavy negative space.
grids.category_bento: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-12 gap-8 with overlapping image frames. E.g., Hero image spans 8 cols, secondary spans 4 cols.
grids.products: grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4 with gap-6. Keep it clean and aligned.

layout_and_spacing.borders_and_surfaces: Soft skeuomorphism. 1px solid borders in #E5DCC5 (soft gold/champagne). Subtle, diffuse shadows (shadow-xl with 10% opacity) for floating cards.

motion_and_interactions.hero_animation: Slow, cinematic zoom on the hero image. Staggered fade-up and slide-up for headings and CTAs.
motion_and_interactions.ambient_effects: Subtle floating particles (like rose petals or gold dust) in the background of the hero or featured sections using framer-motion.

hover_states.buttons: Slight scale up (scale-105), shadow expands, background transitions smoothly from Crimson to deeper Maroon.
hover_states.product_cards: Image slow zoom on hover. A subtle gold border glow or metallic shimmer sweeps across the card.

motion_and_interactions.scroll: Smooth section reveals. Fade in and slide up for sections as they enter the viewport.

components.buttons: Sharp corners or very subtle rounding (rounded-sm). Use 'Deep Crimson' background with 'Warm Ivory' text. Add an inner border of 1px gold for luxury feel.
components.navigation: Sticky, glassmorphism header (backdrop-blur-xl bg-[#FDFAF6]/80) with a 1px border-b in champagne. Center-aligned logo in Serif. Shopping cart icon with red dot notification.
components.cart_drawer: Slide-over drawer from the right. Must include animated entrance. Clear typography for order summary, elegant quantity increment/decrement controls.
components.testimonials: Carousel with soft cross-fades. Quote text in large Serif (italicized).
components.inputs: Underlined inputs (border-b only) or softly rounded borders. No heavy boxy inputs. Minimalist and elegant.

hero.description: A woman in traditional indian attire smiles gently. Perfect for the main editorial hero.
hero.usage: Main Hero Background or Asymmetrical Hero Image

category_mehndi.description: Intricate henna designs on hands in close-up.

category_sindoor_bindi.description: Close-up portrait of an Indian woman in traditional jewelry with closed eyes.

category_payal.description: Female legs in precious golden anklets on a dark background.

category_cosmetics.description: Close-up of a bold red lipstick with a metallic casing.

instructions_to_main_agent: Use framer-motion for ALL micro-interactions, especially the floating petals and smooth page scroll reveals.
Avoid standard Vercel/Shadcn UI boxed looks. Strip the borders and heavy backgrounds; rely on negative space, typography, and subtle 1px champagne borders.
DO NOT USE INTER OR ROBOTO. Enforce Playfair Display for headings and Outfit for body. You may need to import these from Google Fonts in index.css.
Build a functional, animated shopping cart drawer (slide-in from right). Include quantity controls and remove-item functionality.
Ensure the hero section has an editorial, high-end fashion magazine feel, not a basic SaaS layout.
Apply 'data-testid' to all buttons, navigation links, and cart controls.
For the ambient animations, create a dedicated 'FloatingPetals' or 'GoldDust' component using framer-motion floating divs layered absolutely in the background with z-[-1] and low opacity.
